problem.observer_locked: Observer mode cannot be switched while connected. Disconnect first, then change it.
problem.nothing_to_send: Nothing to send: the message is empty, or there is neither a recipient nor a COM1 frequency
problem.not_xplane: This directory does not look like an X-Plane installation (it has no Resources/plugins)

status.no_mouse_ptt: Mouse side buttons cannot be used for PTT on this system

voice.evicted: This account signed in elsewhere; voice disconnected

login.observer_note: For the right seat: voice only, without a second aircraft on the network. Each pilot needs their own account.
login.follow_tip: The callsign of the captain's aircraft. The voice server measures your range from its position.

observer.frequency_tip: Observer mode only: type a frequency and voice stays on it. Clear it to follow the cockpit COM1 again.
observer.no_frequency: No frequency yet: type one here, or keep the simulator running to follow COM1

chat.recipient: Recipient (leave blank to send on frequency)
chat.observer_no_text: Observers do not send or receive text messages

plan.offline: Not connected yet. Connect first, then file.
plan.observer: Observers are not on the network; the captain files the flight plan

local.inject_note: When off, you have the sky to yourself; voice is unaffected
local.chime: Play a chime for ATC messages
local.chime_all: Chime for every message on frequency
local.chime_all_note: By default only messages naming your callsign chime; private messages always do
local.chime_note: The chime plays on the headset selected above, not the system default device. If the preview is silent, the wrong device is selected.
local.range_note: NM. TCAS has only 64 slots; a smaller range keeps them for the closest aircraft.

csl.dir_placeholder: Leave blank to use the X-Plane folder
csl.empty: No models in {path}, so no traffic will be drawn. Multi-GB CSL packages often live on another drive; if so, enter that path here.

ptt.title: Push to talk (PTT)
ptt.unresolved: This binding is not recognised on this system; record it again
ptt.wayland: This system runs Wayland, which does not let ordinary programs listen for global keys, so keyboard PTT will not work. Use a joystick button instead.
ptt.no_mouse: Mouse side buttons cannot be used for PTT on this system.

plugin.version_mismatch: The X-Plane plugin speaks protocol version {version}, which does not match this client. It will drop every frame and no traffic will appear. Reinstall it under “Local setup → X-Plane traffic plugin” below.
plugin.not_heard: The X-Plane plugin has not been heard from. Voice is unaffected, but no traffic will be drawn. Install it under “Local setup → X-Plane traffic plugin” below, and make sure XPPython3 is installed and X-Plane is running.
plugin.title: X-Plane traffic plugin
plugin.why: Without it, voice and connecting work normally, but no other aircraft will appear in the sky.

state.no_root: X-Plane was not found. Enter where it is installed below.
state.not_xplane: This directory does not look like an X-Plane installation: it has no Resources/plugins.
state.outdated: The installed copy differs from the one bundled with this client; updating is recommended.

plugin.no_xppython3: XPPython3 is not in this directory. The plugin will not run without it, because it runs inside XPPython3. Install XPPython3 first (v4.x for X-Plane 12, v3.1.5 for 11.52; the wrong major version silently does nothing).
plugin.protocol_mismatch: The installed copy speaks protocol {installed}; this client speaks {bundled}. When they differ, the plugin drops every frame, no traffic appears, and both logs stay clean. Update with the button below.
plugin.installed: Installed: {path}. If X-Plane is running, restart it to load the plugin.

manual.explain: You can also copy it by hand: this client was installed with a copy of the plugin, in the folder below. Copy {file} from it into {target} inside your X-Plane folder (create that folder if it does not exist). If X-Plane is installed somewhere that needs administrator rights, the system will ask; allow it. Restart X-Plane if it is running.
